name: auth-page
title: Auth Page
description: AuthPage: a centred, brand-led page for signing in, registering from a one-time link and recovering an account, with a logo, a title, a description, one primary action, other options, an alert slot and footer links. `status` (idle, working, error, success) marks the action pending and announces `workingLabel` while a ceremony such as WebAuthn is open, shows the error in a live destructive Alert with a retry, and swaps the actions for a success slot. It holds no auth logic.
docs: `<AuthPage logo={<Brand />} title="Sign in" description="…" status={status} action={{ label: "Sign in with a passkey", icon: <KeyRoundIcon />, onAction: signIn }} workingLabel="Waiting for your passkey" error="The passkey request was cancelled." retry={{ label: "Try again" }} success={<Alert tone="success">…</Alert>} secondary={<Button variant="link">Recover your account</Button>} footer={<><Link href="/terms">Terms</Link>…</>} />`. Put fields (a name, a recovery code) in `children`, between the description and the action, and a note for any status (who invited you, when the link expires) in `alert`. `working` gives the action `loading` (a spinner, `aria-busy`, presses ignored while it keeps focus) and reads `workingLabel` once, politely; `error` shows `error` in an `Alert tone="destructive" live` whose retry runs `retry.onRetry`, or the action again; `success` replaces the action and `secondary` with `success`. The card is at most `--auth-page-width` (26rem) wide and the page at least `--auth-page-height` (100dvh) tall, padded clear of the safe areas, so it fills a phone at 390px. Every visible word comes from you: there is no default copy.
